clause_text: The Bank may, at its sole discretion and without prior notice or assigning any reason, refuse authorisation for a transaction at a merchant establishment, restrict or defer usage of the Card, or suspend/cancel the Card.

ZestMoney may, at its sole discretion, at any time and without advance notice or liability, suspend, terminate or restrict your access to all or any component of the website or the availability of the website itself.
Paytm assumes no responsibility and shall incur no liability if it is unable to affect any payment instruction(s) on the payment date owing to circumstances beyond the control of Paytm.

All fees and charges applicable to the loan must be clearly disclosed to the borrower upfront in the Key Fact Statement and loan agreement, and no fee outside this disclosure may be levied at any later stage of the loan tenor.

Processing fees, charged once before disbursal, foreclosure charges, and part-prepayment charges must each be disclosed as a distinct line item rather than folded into a single combined "other charges" figure.
If the Credit Card is not used for more than 365 days, Reward Points accrued will be nullified.

Fair usage charges apply on Fuel, Utility, Education, Rent, and Transportation spends: a 1% charge is levied on aggregate spends exceeding specified monthly thresholds in these categories, charged before the 15th of the next calendar month.
What happens if I don't pay my bill by the due date? No late payment charges will be applied.

I understand that sanction of the facility is at the sole discretion of axio and its co-lender and they reserve the right to reject my application for the facility without assigning any reasons whatsoever.
The Cardmember can use the Card to access cash in an emergency from ATMs in India or abroad.
The net disbursed amount to the borrower equals the loan amount minus all up-front charges, and this net figure must be shown to the borrower distinctly from the gross loan amount.
Paytm reserves the right to change, modify, add, or remove portions of this Agreement at any time by posting notification on the Paytm Platform or otherwise communicating the notification to You.

No charge or fee other than those disclosed in the Key Fact Statement at the time of sanction shall be charged by the lender to the borrower during the loan tenor without the borrower's explicit consent.
You agree that Paytm, in its sole discretion, for any or no reason, and without penalty, may suspend or terminate Your account or Your use of the Paytm Services/Paytm Platform at any time.

Failure to pay the overdue amount within the specified notice period may result in the lenders sharing default details with credit agencies and initiating legal proceedings for recovery, without further individual notice to the Borrower.

Why is my Flipkart EMI account blocked? Your account can be blocked due to: overdue payments or your repayment was post 30 days past due date; breach of Flipkart Advanz's T&C; breach of lending partner's T&C; due to internal Flipkart policies; due to our lending partner's internal policies.
Interest will be charged at up to 3% per month (36.00% annualized) as per the sole discretion of IDFC FIRST Bank and shall be final and binding to the Card member.
Priority Pass lounge usage charges of $35 plus taxes will be applicable for all Domestic and International Airport lounge visits within India after exceeding complimentary visits.
Paytm shall not be liable to pay any refunds whatsoever in cases where the airline closes its operations or declares itself as insolvent or has been declared as insolvent in any legal proceedings.
Suitable prior notice would be provided to the customers before any changes are made to the charges.

The Lenders will have the right to share the Borrower's default details with Credit Information Companies (CICs), and a default history against the Borrower's name could jeopardize the Borrower's future creditworthiness.
The award of the arbitrator shall be final and binding on all concerned parties.
The entity providing the service has the right to update the charges levied.
You are bound by such revisions and should therefore visit the Paytm Platform to review the applicable fees which may vary from time to time.

The bank, at any time and without notice, will have lien and right to set-off on all monies belonging to the Cardmember and/or add on Cardmember standing to their credit in any account/custody of the bank, if upon demand by the bank, the balance amount on the card account is not repaid within the prescribed time.

The Bank shall further reserve the right to disclose the information to any third party, in case the disclosure of the same is for obtaining any additional service/products which may be beneficial to the customer, as per the sole assessment and discretion of the Bank.
If the Cardmember has acted fraudulently the Cardmember will be liable for all losses.
These charges are subject to change as per changes in lender pricing policy and T&Cs changes and shall be duly communicated to you.
Bank's decision in this regard shall be final and binding on the customers.
Paytm and/or the Paytm business partner reserve the right to charge and recover from You, such fees for availing the service as the case may be.
All the Contents of the statement will be deemed to be correct and accepted if the Cardmember does not inform HDFC Bank of the discrepancies within 60 days of the Statement Date in writing.
Foreclosure charge of 3.39% of your unbilled principal outstanding amount will be applicable.
All unused or unredeemed reward points or cashback shall automatically be forfeited immediately after voluntary or involuntary cancellation.
Paytm may make changes to any Paytm Services offered on the Paytm Platform, or to the applicable terms for any such Paytm Services, at any time, without notice.

Charges for switching between loan products, statement re-issuance, mandate cancellation, and cheque re-issuance are each levied separately and are not included within the headline interest rate quoted to the borrower at the time of sanction.
The cooling off/look-up period is the time window which allows the customer to exit EMI loans without any penalty.
For retail purchases, balance transfer, cash advances, non-payment of minimum amount due, late payment etc. the APR is the same.
Payment Return Charges: 2% of total amount due or ₹500, whichever is higher, applicable on Cheque, ECS/NACH, or Autopay Return failures.

Provision of the Facility is at the discretion of the Lending Partner, and every Lending Partner reserves the right to reject the Facility to a customer, with or without any notice or reason and without any liability.
The amount of the Facility may be modified and the Facility may be cancelled by your Lending Partner at its sole discretion, and without assigning any reason and without any liability.
